name: BITEZ - D8 + D9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Strawberry Shortcake - Limited Edition
description:
An exclusive drop you don't want to miss. Our Limited Edition Strawberry Shortcake BITEZ blend luscious strawberry with creamy vanilla cake for a flavor experience that's pure indulgence. Each artisanal gummy packs a potent 1,000mg blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP. Two exquisitely crafted pieces per pack. This won't last—when this limited release sells out, it's gone for good.

Strawberry Shortcake layers juicy Strawberry with rich Creamy Vanilla Cake flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
